name: procrastination-repo
description: Not an npm workspace: apps/site (Next 14, React 18) and apps/app (Expo SDK 57, React 19) each keep their own node_modules. packages/core is dependency-free TS imported by apps/app via the @pn/core alias.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/site ci && npm --prefix apps/app ci
scripts.app:check: cd apps/app && npx tsc --noEmit && npx expo lint
